newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Kiwi Income buys property portfolio.
newsitem.headline: Kiwi Income buys property portfolio.

text.p: Kiwi Income Property Trust said on Friday it conditionally agreed to acquire a portfolio of CBD property interests from Sentry Investments Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of General Accident.
The purchase price is $130 million. The portfolio consists of interests in five prime commercial properties in the main centres of Auckland, Wellington and Christchurch.

The chairman of Kiwi Income Property Trust, Robert Narev noted that the acquisition of the Sentry portfolio represented a unique opportunity for the Trust to achieve its previously stated objective of increasing the weighting of
the portfolio in favour of prime CBD commercial property, particularly in the Auckland market.
